bool vis[N];
 
int ksm(int x, int y)
{
    int ans = 1;
    while (y)

        if (y & 1) ans = (LL)ans * x % MOD;
        x = (LL)x * x % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;

void init()
{
    bin[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) bin[i] = bin[i - 1] * 2;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)

bool get_match(int x)

            bool flag = get_match(x + 1);
            vis[i] = 0;
            if (flag) return 1;
        }
    return 0;
}
 
void dfs2(int x, int y, int pro)
{

        int s = 0;

    else dfs2(x, y + 1, (LL)pro * (1 - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD);
    ma[a[x]][y] = 1;

    else dfs2(x, y + 1, (LL)pro * p[a[x]][y] % MOD);
